name: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Medical Assistance
benefit:
- Medical treatment benefits are provided under [Deendayal Antyodaya Upchar Yojana](https://www.mpedistrict.gov.in/MPL/getphoto.aspx?ViewCircular=eVTeefDvS1Q=) through the Public Health and Family Welfare Department.- Financial assistance for serious or life-threatening diseases may be provided under the State Illness Assistance Fund, subject to eligibility and approval.

_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should hold a valid commercial driver or conductor license issued in Madhya Pradesh. 1. The applicant should be registered on the Samagra Portal. 1. The applicant should be a registered transport vehicle driver or conductor under the scheme. 1. The applicant or eligible family member should require medical treatment as per scheme provisions.
